description.en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

description.zh:
修改方式，取值含义如下：

- Cover（默认值）：使用ips参数的值覆盖原IP白名单。

- Append：在原IP白名单中增加ips参数中输入的IP地址。

- Delete：在原IP白名单中删除ips参数中输入的IP地址，至少需要保留一个IP地址。
description.en:
The modification method. Valid values:

- Cover (default): overwrites the original IP whitelist with the value of the ips parameter.

- Append: adds the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter to the original IP whitelist.

- Delete: removes the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter from the original IP whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained.

title.zh: 更新实例公网地址访问白名单
title.en: Update instance public endpoint access whitelist

descriptions.zh:
## 注意事项
- 当实例状态为生效中（activating）、失效（invalid）和冻结（inactive）时，无法更新实例的公网地址访问白名单。
- 您可以通过两种方式更新白名单：IP白名单列表和IP白名单组。两种方式不能同时使用，且除了InstanceId和clientToken外，两种方式支持配置的参数也不同，具体如下：   
    - IP白名单列表：publicIpWhitelist
    - IP白名单组：modifyMode、whiteIpGroup
- 公网访问白名单不支持配置私网IP地址，私网访问白名单不支持配置公网IP地址。
descriptions.en:
## Before you begin
- You cannot update the public endpoint access whitelist of an instance when the instance status is activating, invalid, or inactive (freeze).
- You can update the whitelist in two ways: IP whitelist list and IP whitelist group. The two methods cannot be used at the same time. In addition to InstanceId and clientToken, the two methods support different parameters:   
    - IP whitelist list: publicIpWhitelist
    - IP whitelist group: modifyMode, whiteIpGroup
- The public network access whitelist does not support private network IP addresses, and the private network access whitelist does not support public network IP addresses.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-public-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-tl329rbpc00010000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --modify-mode Cover --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
